title: Serina Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates
summary: Enrollment and dosing completed in Cohort 1 of Phase 1b registrational study of SER-252 - Top-line data from the single-ascending-dose arm targeted for the first half of 2027 - Appointment of Farrell Simon, Pharm.D., to the Board of Directors - HUNTSVILLE, Aug. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Serina Therapeutics, Inc.
